t: TWO Unpickable (?) Locks for Lock Picking Lawyer!

q.x: One such effort features locks made by Stuff Made Here sent to Lock Picking Lawyer. According to LPL the locks are theoretically sound and he did not attempt to pick them, but these particular implementations had a couple (easily fixable) bypasses.
